translations: take you in light estimation those who
puzzle.hint: A call to patience and steadfastness, affirming that Allah's promise is certainly true and urging the believer not to be shaken by disbelievers.
puzzle.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
